description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commands and behaviors, including setup, commands like update-index, ls-files, cat-file, diff-files, write-tree, checkout-index, read-tree, alias expansion, GIT_PREFIX, and validations inside repositories.

methods.name: test_write_lines

methods.name: test_expect_success

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test finishes.

methods.description: Compares two files or data streams to verify they are identical.
